description: Extend the ingest pipeline (app/ingest/csv_source.py + run.py) to load from the existing data/raw/pokeapi CSVs: moves (id, type_id, damage_class, power, pp, accuracy) via moves.csv + move_names.csv + move_damage_classes.csv; the per-species legal learnset via pokemon_moves.csv (restrict to default-form pokemon we already ingest; keep learn method + level from pokemon_move_methods.csv); and natures via natures.csv + nature_names.csv (increased/decreased stat). Add SQLAlchemy models: Move, PokemonMove (learnset link, method/level), Nature. Add an Alembic migration. NEVER call PokéAPI at runtime — CSV only. Wire into `make data`.
title: Ingest moves, learnsets & natures from local CSVs
